description: This file defines the EmployeeSkill class, which extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, primarily used for filtering employee skills in reports within the HRM system. It includes methods to modify query builders based on skill filters, convert skill IDs to array representations, and provide entity aliases, indicating its role as part of the reporting filter functionality related to employee skills.

classes.name: EmployeeSkill
classes.description: A class representing a filter field for employee skills used in HRM reporting, capable of applying skill-based filters to database queries and converting skill IDs to descriptive arrays.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to include a condition filtering for a specific skill if the operator is EQUAL and a skill ID (X) is provided.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the aliases used for entities in query operations; here, it returns a list containing 'skill'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Transforms the skill ID (X) into an array containing the skill's ID and name if the skill exists, else returns null.
